people.name: Agag
people.line: Amalekite king captured and killed by Samuel

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me!” Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”
translations.bsb: Then Samuel said, “Bring me Agag king of the Amalekites.” Agag came to him cheerfully, for he thought, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”
translations.kjv: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.
translations.asv: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him cheerfully. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.
